assumptions.trend: Same readMarketFoundation primary trend as live Analyze V2. Trend-only entries bypass its trade checklist. Higher alignment is recorded, not a filter.
assumptions.fills: Signal on completed candle, fill at next M15 open. Ask buy / bid sell plus slippage on each side. Entry expires across a gap.
assumptions.losses: No stop loss. If net P&L <= 0 at any M15 close at/after holdDays from entry, exit next available open. Profitable trades may exceed holdDays.
assumptions.winners: Primary close retreats pullbackAtr * fixed entry ATR from best favorable primary close since entry, AND net P&L > 0; exit next M15 open. Gap may make the realized exit a loss.
assumptions.finance: Signed annualized opening USD notional / 365, accrued over calendar time including weekends. Positive rate is a charge. Estimate, not historical OANDA roll/swap rates.
assumptions.margin: Fixed opening notional / leverage required for entry. Liquidate at NAV <= closeoutFraction * opening margin (worst open for gaps); halt account afterward. Simplified, not exact OANDA rules.
assumptions.drawdown: Close-equity peaks against every M15 adverse extreme, including floating losses and estimated exit costs. Conservative bar approximation.
assumptions.news: No historical news filter; calendar is not consulted for trend-only entries.
assumptions.sample: Retrospective exploratory sample. Analyze was developed on overlapping history; no claim of unseen/out-of-sample validation.
assumptions.end: Remaining position marked to market with estimated exit costs, kept separate from closed-trade win rate and profit factor.
